comment: The sharp turn shown in a set of looks. Grain Round and Bristle Flat each paint at two sizes, a small one of 0.04 and a large one of 0.08 of the canvas's short side, through a turn of 45, 90 and 135 degrees and a hairpin of 160, on a plain 1000 by 700 document with View > Show Relief on. Each is one stroke at a constant pressure of 0.35, a light touch so the texture decides more of it, on a layer of its own over a paper fill, a straight leg of 350 pixels from the left into the corner at (500, 220) and a second leg of 350 pixels leaving it at the turn's angle, clockwise on screen, so the 90 turn goes straight down and the hairpin comes back nearly along its first leg. A look of the colour and a shot of the lit canvas are taken of every turn, named preset, size and turn, 16 of each. The look holds the colour alone and the shot carries the relief, since the light is the canvas's own. Nothing is saved.
